meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen's zero. Before we start, who decided to enter it, and did anyone speak to Owen or to me first?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me. Who decided on the zero, Hale?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job? Withdraw the zero, Hale. I'm still waiting to hear who entered it before anyone called me.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why are we here? On a team, nobody enters a zero before calling his mother. Withdraw it, Hale.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: Principal

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn and that you tell me in writing who entered it before anyone contacted me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: the opening position, with the zero still standing and nothing agreed.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "how I should handle this" cost Hale her respect, though it did not change her position.
Try next time: when she asked who decided on the zero and whether anyone spoke to Owen or to her first, answer in one sentence that the zero went in before the call, then show her a dated document instead of complimenting her.
